_doc: Cloud Store > Torrent catalogue (#1681), served at runtime as shared/torrent-catalogue (never baked into an APK). (#1749: Search > Torrent recommends the top 10 per category from here, after the licence and source allowlist in StoreRecs; archive.org items are the open collections of public-domain, Creative Commons and open-source works.) ONLY legitimately distributable items: each entry's info_hash was computed from the publisher's own official .torrent at torrent_url, and its magnet carries that hash plus the publisher's trackers. Categories keep the owner's structure so more legitimate entries can be added; a category with no entry is drawn as empty. Copyrighted or cracked content is never listed here. Users add their own entries in Configs > Torrent (kept on the device).
